Required findings: Imaging must demonstrate severe unicompartmental osteoarthritis: Kellgren-Lawrence Grade IV radiograph, OR Outerbridge Grade IV arthroscopy, OR Modified Outerbridge Grade IV MRI, OR unicompartmental avascular necrosis of femoral condyle/proximal tibia.
Physical examination must document knee stability and an arc of motion from full extension to >90° flexion.

Symptoms must include function‑limiting pain at short distances (e.g., <¼ mile or two city blocks) for ≥3 months and loss of knee function that interferes with age‑appropriate ADLs or employment demands.
Failure of provider‑directed non‑surgical management for ≥3 months (e.g., physical therapy, NSAIDs, injections) unless the medical record clearly explains why such management is inappropriate.
Surgeon must verify optimization of modifiable medical and behavioral health comorbidities prior to surgery.

Non-Indications: Imaging shows less than Kellgren-Lawrence Grade IV or Outerbridge/MRI grade <IV.
Knee instability or range of motion ≤90°.
Pain duration <3 months or pain not function‑limiting.
No documented loss of function affecting ADLs or employment.
Absence of a completed ≥3‑month trial of non‑surgical therapy when such therapy is appropriate.
Patient is a candidate for a joint‑sparing procedure.
Failure to document optimization of modifiable medical/behavioral comorbidities.
Important criteria & exceptions: Non‑surgical management may be deemed inappropriate; the record must explicitly document the reason.
All listed criteria must be met; missing any element renders the procedure not medically necessary.
Documentation required: Radiology report of weight‑bearing knee X‑rays with Kellgren-Lawrence grading.
Arthroscopy report with Outerbridge classification (if performed).
MRI report with Modified Outerbridge grading (if performed).
Clinical note documenting knee stability and range of motion >90°.
History and physical note describing pain duration ≥3 months, functional limitation, and impact on ADLs/employment.
Records of non‑surgical management (physical therapy notes, medication logs, injection records) covering ≥3 months, or a provider statement explaining why such management was not pursued.
Pre‑operative medical clearance note confirming optimization of modifiable medical and behavioral health conditions.
